summary: Reset-to-composition is now available whenever the user layer owns at least one override (or local staged edits exist), not only after the browser draft becomes dirty. A pure canStageReset(storedOverrides, dirty) predicate in rlm-settings-model.ts gates the card button, and a model regression pins the clean-draft-with-overrides case (Issue #80).

pointers: Issue#80 reset available with clean draft

steps: Verified at 5a1b6e1: disabled={!editable || dirty.size === 0} left Reset permanently disabled on a clean card even when snapshot.user carried stored overrides.
No React test harness exists in the repo (no jsdom/testing-library), so the gate predicate lives in the pure model where node --test can pin it.
limitations: Component-level rendering is not covered (no React test tooling); the card consumes the same predicate.
